sample_selection: one prespecified complete PBMC sample from each of eight independent donors: 1B, 5B, 10A, 11B, 16A, 19A, 20A, and 22A
normalization: each endpoint count and frequency divided by its corresponding matched ungated-input value; Raw = 1 for both metrics

frequency_definitions.live_cd45: percentage of Live cells before matched-Raw normalization
frequency_definitions.b_cells: percentage of Live cells before matched-Raw normalization
frequency_definitions.t_cells: percentage of Live cells before matched-Raw normalization
frequency_definitions.nkt_cells: percentage of Live cells before matched-Raw normalization

matched_ungated_inputs.time: Expert singlet + debris masks, without a time mask
matched_ungated_inputs.debris: Expert time + doublet masks, without a debris mask
matched_ungated_inputs.doublet: Expert time + debris masks, without a doublet mask
matched_ungated_inputs.all steps: no time, debris, or doublet preprocessing mask
